realtime_memories.content: Turborepo monorepo with 9 subdomain apps (www, thoughts, dev, links, updates, metrics, status, lab, docs) and shared packages (ui, lib, types, config, styles). Three-layer shared system: @anipotts/lib (plain helpers) → @anipotts/ui (client components with callback props) → per-app actions.ts (thin 'use server' wrappers). Shared packages built with tsup. GitHub: https://github.com/anipotts/anipotts.com.

Accent: #61ABEA (blue). Handles: @anipottsbuilds (social), @anipotts (GitHub/LinkedIn). Email: contact@anipotts.com. Bio: 'minimal interfaces to orchestrate complex systems'. Terminal header: 'ani@potts:~/[domain]' with responsive prefix hiding. Font: JetBrains Mono. Design tokens in packages/styles/src/tokens.css (light in :root, dark in .dark).

Shared data in @anipotts/lib with tsup multi-entry builds. Modules: data/ (projects, social, site with subdomains array, services, SITE_VERSION), admin/ (auth, thoughts CRUD), metrics/ (GitHub/WakaTime, Supabase cache), status/ (HTTP checker). Supabase tables: thoughts, metrics_cache, status_checks, favorite_numbers. Vercel Crons: metrics daily 6AM UTC, status every 5 min. Import Supabase via @anipotts/lib/supabase. Env vars: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY (www only), NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, ADMIN_PASSWORD, GITHUB_TOKEN, WAKATIME_API_KEY, CRON_SECRET. Use printf (not echo) for env vars. Dev: 'pnpm turbo dev --concurrency=15'.

Admin accessed via Cmd+Shift+A (hidden), cookie-based auth per domain. TerminalNavigator (Ctrl+`) on all 9 apps via @anipotts/ui/terminal-navigator — replaced old SubdomainNavigator modal (Jan 31). ./server export uses source path (not dist) to avoid tsup dual-config issues. Shared next config in packages/config/next/base.ts — DO NOT use serverExternalPackages for framer-motion (breaks SSG). Use turbopack.resolveAlias for node:fs stub. PostHog only configured on www Vercel project.

Jan 29: Ecosystem unification — shared data layer, admin system, real GitHub+WakaTime metrics, HTTP status monitoring. Jan 30: Light/dark/system theme (ThemeProvider + ThemeScript + ThemeToggle, CSS variable tokens). Deep cleanup — 10 parallel review agents → 8-phase plan: security fixes, dead code removal (~1000 lines), dependency alignment (framer-motion 12.23.25, React 19.2.1), shared next config, layout dedup, type safety, accessibility, CLI app removed. Jan 31: Terminal Navigator — slide-up interactive terminal replacing SubdomainNavigator, 12 commands (help, ls, cd, open, pwd, whoami, clear, echo, neofetch, ping, history, exit), tab completion, command history, spring animation, deployed to all 9 apps. All apps build + typecheck clean.

Consolidated 14 memories down to 5. Removed all noise (raw message captures, truncated user messages, claude_response fragments) and merged environment + data layer into one entry. Updated conventions
